name: What are the signs I need a new water heater installed?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs I need a new water heater installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that indicate you might need a new water heater include inconsistent water temperature, discolored or rusty hot water, strange noises like rumbling or popping from the tank, and visible leaks around the unit. A significant decrease in hot water supply or an increase in energy bills without other apparent reasons can also signal that your water heater is struggling. An average lifespan for a conventional tank water heater is 10-15 years, so age is a critical factor in determining if replacement is needed. Our technicians can assess your unit's performance and provide an expert recommendation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include inconsistent water temperature, rusty water, strange noises, leaks, reduced hot water, or increased energy bills, especially if the unit is over 10 years old.
